headline: 泥面人领跑电影，夜行杀机开播
summary: 本周影市热作包括《泥面人》《荒野丛林》等；新剧《夜行杀机》《末路兼职》《完美的谎言》首播，热播剧《侠探杰克》《水晶湖》持续吸睛。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：泥面人、荒野丛林、克拉拉与太阳、柳条人、愤怒的老虎
industryHighlights.en: Film heat: Clayface, Wildwood, Klara and the Sun, The Wicker Man, Angry Tiger

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：夜行杀机、末路兼职、完美的谎言
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Night Kill, Side Hustle, Perfect Lie

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：侠探杰克、水晶湖、赛博朋克：边缘行者、魔女嘉莉、无职转生
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: Reacher, Crystal Lake, Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, Carrie, Mushoku Tensei

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：复仇者联盟5、沙丘3、银翼杀手2099、再婚皇后
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Blade Runner 2099, The Remarried Empress

headlineEn: Clayface Leads Films, Night Kill Premieres
summaryEn: This week’s film slate is led by Clayface and Wildwood; new series Night Kill, Side Hustle, and Perfect Lie premiere, while Reacher and Crystal Lake remain hot.
